source: Captured on 2026-11-12 from AIM 5.1.3036, AIM 5.9.3861 and AIM 3.5 through a server with a relay. Each proposal, counter-offer and accept is the value of tag 0x05 of a channel 2 message, as the server delivered it. The address of the server is replaced with 203.0.113.7. Some file names and the screen name are replaced with names of the same length. The OFT headers of the Send File links of this capture are in aim-oft.json.

vectors.name: 5.1 get file proposal
vectors.note: From AIM 5.1.3036, when its user chose Get File on a buddy. Tag 0x2711 holds 12 bytes: 0x0012, a count of 1 and zeros. AIM 5.1 stops when it gets a Get File proposal that has no tag 0x2711.

vectors.name: 5.9 get file proposal
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861, when its user chose Get File on a buddy. Tag 0x2711 holds 9 bytes: 0x0012, the number 2, then 00000001 00. Tag 0x2712 holds the text us-ascii. AIM 5.1 writes the number 1 in the same place.

vectors.name: 3.5 get file proposal
vectors.note: From AIM 3.5, when its user chose Get File on a buddy. Tag 0x2711 holds the same 12 bytes as the proposal of AIM 5.1, with the number 1. Tag 0x0F comes after the port.

vectors.name: 5.1 proposal, one file
vectors.note: From AIM 5.1.3036. One file of 1513 bytes, README.txt. Zero bytes follow the name inside tag 0x2711.

vectors.name: 5.1 proposal, one file of 12 MB
vectors.note: From AIM 5.1.3036. One file of 12027554 bytes, IMG_0495.jpeg. The count of zero bytes after the name is not the same as for README.txt.

vectors.name: 5.1 proposal, a folder
vectors.note: From AIM 5.1.3036. A folder of 3 files, 231353 bytes in total. The name is the name of the folder, then a backslash and a star.

vectors.name: 5.9 proposal, one file
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861. One file of 7750 bytes. Tags 0x0E, 0x0D, 0x0C and 0x2712 are present. One zero byte follows the name.

vectors.name: 5.9 proposal, one file, long name
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861. One file of 18518232 bytes with a name of 34 characters.

vectors.name: 5.9 proposal, one file, a program
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861. One file of 2598120 bytes. The recipient declined this offer.

vectors.name: 5.9 proposal, a folder
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861. A folder of 16 files, 1030852 bytes in total. The name is the name of the folder and nothing more.

vectors.name: counter-offer after the recipient connected
vectors.note: Sequence 2, as the offerer got it when AIM 5.1.3036 accepted. The same tags came when AIM 5.9.3861 accepted. No tag 0x2711.

vectors.name: 5.9 accept
vectors.note: From AIM 5.9.3861, on the server connection, after the peer connection opened. The 26-byte head only. AIM 5.1.3036 sent none.

vectors.name: client error body, decline
vectors.note: The body of the client error (family 0x04, subtype 0x0B) that AIM 5.1.3036 and AIM 5.9.3861 send to decline. Cookie, channel 2, an 11-character name, code 3, then 0x0002 and 0x0001.
